steps.note: ProxyProtocolOriginalDestinationHandlerTest: PROXY protocol headers in transparent-proxy mode. The PROXY protocol handler sits before the PortUnificationHandler (b765b8271), so what follows a header is classified as any connection's first bytes are; the header's destination is where unmatched requests would go
answers the request that comes without a header

tcp.text:
PROXY TCP4 192.168.1.1 127.0.0.1 56324 {{deadport}}
GET /behind-proxy HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Connection: close

steps.note: ProxyProtocolOriginalDestinationHandlerTest.shouldParseValidProxyV1Tcp4Header (a refusing address in place of the test's 10.0.0.1:80): the request after the header matches the expectation

tcp.text:
PROXY TCP6 ::1 ::1 56324 {{deadport}}
GET /behind-proxy HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Connection: close

GET /behind-proxy HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Connection: close

PROXY UNKNOWN
GET /behind-proxy HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Connection: close
